exclusions.source_text: Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status ≤ 2.
Total bilirubin ≤ 3x ULN without liver metastases and \< 5x ULN in presence of liver metastases.
exclusions.threshold: Total bilirubin <= 3x ULN without liver metastases; < 5x ULN with liver metastases

exclusions.source_text: Aspartate aminotransferase (AST) and alanine aminotransferase (ALT) ≤ 3x ULN without liver metastases and \< 5x ULN in the presence of liver metastases
exclusions.threshold: AST/ALT <= 3x ULN without liver metastases; < 5x ULN with liver metastases

exclusions.source_text: Females of child-bearing potential who are lactating, have a positive pregnancy test at Screening, or are unwilling to use acceptable contraception prior to study entry and for the duration of study participation until at least 4 weeks after study completion.
